p: righteousness is more than God's: Job never spoke these words: but because he maintained his innocency, it seemed as though he would say, that God tormented him without just cause.
companions with thee: Such as are in the same error.
clouds which are higher than thou: If you cannot control the clouds, will you presume to instruct God?
against him: Neither does your sin hurt God, nor your justice profit him: for he will be glorified without you.
to cry: The wicked may hurt man and cause him to cry, who if he sought God who lends comfort would be delivered.
but none giveth answer: Because they pray not in faith, as feeling God's mercies.
yet judgment is before him: God is just, however you judge him.
open his mouth in vain: For if he punished you as you deserved, you would not be able to open your mouth.
